description: Main window: core events and window dragging, every app command including the agent runs (list_recipes, list_providers, start_run, cancel_run, list_runs), project updates (list_updates, apply_update, undo_update, dismiss_update, edit_update, join_update, set_auto_update, set_update_sources), drift (list_drift, refresh_drift, link_branch, ignore_branch) waiting items (list_waiting, set_waiting, confirm_waiting), the command field (command_preview, command_apply, command_undo, capture_task) and the inbox suggestions and agent (inbox_suggestions, inbox_agent, inbox_agent_answer, inbox_agent_check, inbox_agent_paste) and the in-app agent session (agent_session_start, agent_session_get, agent_session_send, agent_session_answer, agent_session_interrupt, agent_session_stop, agent_session_close). Vault access goes through the app's own commands.
